headline: Persebaya Surabaya Secures Victory Against Western Australia Team
metaDescription: Persebaya Surabaya defeated Western Australia 4-3 in an international friendly held at the Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium in Surabaya, Indonesia.
aiSummaryBullets: Persebaya Surabaya won a high-scoring international friendly match against Western Australia with a final score of 4-3.
The match, held at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, featured consecutive second-half goals from substitutes Risto Mitrevski and Alfan Suaib.
Persebaya head coach Bernardo Tavares prioritized team evaluation, while Western Australia coach Ivan Zuvela expressed pride in his players' performance.
aiContextParagraph: On November 15, 2026, the Indonesian football club Persebaya Surabaya played an international friendly match against a team representing Western Australia at the Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium in Surabaya. The game concluded with a 4-3 victory for Persebaya. The match saw a total of seven goals, with the host team staging a late comeback in the second half through contributions from substitutes Risto Mitrevski and Alfan Suaib. Following the match, Persebaya head coach Bernardo Tavares emphasized the importance of assessing player performance and building team confidence rather than focusing solely on the friendly outcome. Conversely, the head coach of the Western Australia side, Ivan Zuvela, stated that he was proud of his team's effort despite the narrow loss. The event served as a tactical evaluation opportunity for both coaching staff members to analyze their respective squads in a competitive setting.
whyItIsViral: The event generated significant media interest due to the high-scoring, dramatic nature of the international friendly match between a prominent local club and an international visiting squad.
